## Goal

Turn a fun project into something reliable.

## The big idea

Maintenance, backups and monitoring.

## Outline

- Updating the OS and containers safely
- The 3-2-1 backup rule
- What to back up: configs, Minecraft worlds, media metadata
- Testing a restore, because an untested backup isn't a backup
- Uptime Kuma for alerts when something goes down

::: {.callout-warning}
## Break it on purpose
Delete a service's config folder and restore it from backup.
:::
